name: Acorn Finance
headline: Acorn Finance prequal widgets for solar contractor websites
summary: Acorn Finance operates as an open lending marketplace whose flagship contractor tool is an embeddable soft-pull pre-qualification widget — built to capture financially verified leads before a salesperson ever calls.

key_facts.label: Funnel job
key_facts.value: Top-of-funnel conversion on installer marketing sites

key_facts.label: Credit pull
key_facts.value: Soft-pull exploration prior to sales contact

sections.heading: Widget-first, not enterprise-API-first
sections.body: Similar to Hearth’s marketplace model, Acorn emphasizes open lending. Its distinctive contractor surface is the website widget: anonymous visitors can explore financing options without waiting for a kitchen-table appointment. Soft-pull results then pass into the contractor CRM with an approved amount attached.

sections.heading: Why installers embed it
sections.body: Sales teams want certainty about buying power. A prequal widget filters tire-kickers, prioritizes follow-up, and works nationally for developers who operate across state lines. Implementation is typically a snippet or hosted link rather than a months-long Financing API project.

sections.heading: Homeowner tips if you used an Acorn-style widget
sections.body: Screenshot or save the offers shown, confirm soft vs hard pull language, and still request a cash proposal. Prequal maximums are not a reason to oversize a system — model your roof and bill first in SolarFlow, then finance the right kW.

questions_to_ask: Which lenders stand behind the offers the widget returned?
How long is my prequal valid, and what triggers a hard pull?
Can I get a cash price that matches the financed scope exactly?
red_flags: Widget that collects full SSN without clear soft-pull disclosure.
Installer treats prequal max as the system design target instead of your usage and roof.

faqs.question: Does using an Acorn widget lock me into one installer?
faqs.answer: Usually the widget lives on a specific contractor’s site, so leads route to that business. You can still shop other installers and lenders independently.

faqs.question: Is Acorn available in my state?
faqs.answer: The platform positions itself across all fifty U.S. states; confirm product availability on the disclosure screens for your address.
